title: xtp.provision: DHCP-like commissioning over authorised XTP
summary: Proposed privileged named service xtp.provision distributes leased, target-specific MI route/service-point configuration after independently bootstrapped trusted XTP session. Unlike DNS it provisions a signed configuration generation with renewal, revocation and rollback.
invariants: Bootstrap trust anchors and at least one seed route arrive out-of-band and may not be overwritten by an allocation
Node ANNOUNCE is a signed scoped offer, never a self-authorising service-class publication
Controller ALLOCATE must be signed by authorised distinct quorum and addressed to a specific MI
Downloaded allocation cannot launch local service or assert an unregistered live listener
Operations must be idempotent across reconnect and out-of-order delivery
No effectful operation until channel authentication/session binding is genuinely qualified
procedure: HELLO authenticate MI and report applied epoch/revision plus nonce
OFFER challenge/configuration head and policy digest
ANNOUNCE signed node-owned route and service-point offers
REQUEST/ALLOCATE quorum-certified target snapshot or valid delta
PREPARE verify, journal and preflight; ACTIVATE atomic generation; ACK_APPLIED durable not XTP CNTL
RENEW with jitter and bounded lease; WITHDRAW/REVOKE with monotone tombstone floor; SYNC after partition
ROLLBACK to last known good and preserve independent seed reachability

qualification_boundaries.transport: not implemented as secure remote XTP
